paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Zutra: [Gittin 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.38a.13). Rabbah bar Zutra: [Avodah Zarah 28b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.28b.8). Rav Shmuel bar Zutra: [Shabbat 23a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.23a.5).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Gittin 38a paragraph fully names Rabbi Abba bar Zutra; Avodah Zarah 28b names Rabbah bar Zutra; Shabbat 23a fully names Rav Shmuel bar Zutra. These support the separate pointers and local titles, without establishing a common father.

[Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1104&lang=en) indexes the Abba and Rava or Rabbah forms, and [Heilprin’s Shmuel notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3393&lang=en) discusses the two formulations of Shmuel’s teaching about ink. The patronymic list gives no common-father conclusion.
